audits.title: Gracedale Retention Bonus Audit
audits.subject: ARPA-funded retention bonuses for Gracedale employees

findings.finding: Less than half of $5 million allocated for retention bonuses was used for that purpose
findings.detail: Total retention bonuses paid: $2,360,891.18 of $5,000,000 budgeted

findings.finding: Remainder of funds could not be specifically tracked
findings.detail: Funds commingled with other Gracedale funds once transferred in 2023

conclusion.futureIssues: County does not anticipate issues with reporting requirements beyond 2026

returnedFunds.reason: State request due to federal pressure to remit unspent dollars

upcomingDeadlines.requirement: All ARPA SLFRF funds must be spent
